text: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is a listed US company whose largest shareholders are investment firms: its 2026 proxy statement lists BlackRock, Inc. (32,825,572 shares, 11.5%), The Vanguard Group (29,095,385 shares, 10.2%), Wellington Management (8.8%) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (5.8%) as holders of more than 5% of its common stock.
short: Goodyear Tire & Rubber is Nasdaq-listed; its 2026 proxy lists BlackRock (11.5%) and Vanguard (10.2%) as the largest holders.
